description.value:
This scatterblaster is typically called an abomination, even among Darra’s catalog. Its bizarre frontgrip occasionally results in the loss of fingers, and its lack of a stock makes it unsuitable for accuracy — not to mention its sheet metal drum. Though, if you don’t mind your gunsmith gagging when you ask them to smartlink it, the DAS-16 Blazar does excel at spraying buckshot into every corner of a room.

Cost: 750eb (Expensive)

Class: Shotgun • Skill: Handgun • Range: N/A

Damage: N/A • Capacity: 16 (Shell Only) • ROF: 2 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Drum Magazine • Mods: None

Special Features: When this weapon is fired twice in a Round by a user without BODY 9+ or a Cyberarm, they suffer the Crushed Fingers Critical Injury if they do not already have it.

NOTE: This abomination is based on an early exploration for the DS1 Pulsar, made by Mikhail Solovarov, which is amusingly featured in the Cyberpunk 2077: Chrome comic miniseries. Since I don’t want to get in trouble, I won’t link the actual panel it appears on, but in Issue #1 on page 16 it’s held by a beefy dude with a gold necklace, if you want to go see it for yourself.

Range: N/A
Pre-installed: Drum Magazine (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
